name: Shuvo Gold Rates Widget
author: Shuvo Shakil

sections.description:
Shuvo Gold Rates Widget is a powerful and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that displays live gold and silver rates. It features a beautiful widget design, built-in calculator, and historical data display.

External Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party/external API service to retrieve real-time gold and silver rates.

  • Service Name: SEOIndexed Gold Server API
  • Service Provider: SEO Indexed (https://seoindexed.xyz/)
  • Terms of Service: https://seoindexed.xyz/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://seoindexed.xyz/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [sgrw_gold_widget] on any page.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Removed generic shortcode names to comply with WP unique prefix rules.
  • Updated readme.txt to properly declare External Services with Privacy Policy.
